questions.prompt: The city is besieged by the enemy, and its walls are destroyed daily.
questions.answer: Urbs ab hostibus obsidētur, et moenia eius cotidiē dēlentur.

questions.prompt: We are ruled by wise laws which no one dares to break.
questions.answer: Lēgibus sapientibus regimur, quās nēmō frangere audet.

questions.prompt: You are heard by everyone, young man, when you speak clearly in the forum.
questions.answer: Ab omnibus audīris, adulēscēns, cum in forō clārē dīcis.

questions.prompt: The fields are watered by the river, and rich harvests are brought forth.
questions.answer: Agrī ā flūmine rigantur, et ūberēs messēs gignuntur.

questions.prompt: While the war was being waged, the citizens were being terrified by rumors.
questions.answer: Dum bellum gerēbātur, cīvēs rūmōribus terrēbantur.

questions.prompt: I was being praised by the general because I had fought bravely.
questions.answer: Ā duce laudābar, quia fortiter pugnāveram.

questions.prompt: The ships were being driven toward the rocks by a savage wind.
questions.answer: Nāvēs saevō ventō ad saxa prōpellēbantur.

questions.prompt: The traitor will be seized and, bound in chains, led to the prison.
questions.answer: Proditor capiētur et catēnīs vinctus ad carcerem dūcētur.

questions.prompt: You will be loved by the people if you defend their liberty.
questions.answer: Ā populō amāberis, sī lībertātem dēfendēs.

questions.prompt: The temple will be adorned with gold, and the gods will be honored.
questions.answer: Templum aurō ōrnābitur, et deī colentur.

questions.prompt: We will be heard by the senate when the danger becomes known.
questions.answer: Ā senātū audiēmur, cum perīculum nōtum fīet.

questions.prompt: The maiden who is loved by all is called most beautiful.
questions.answer: Virgō quae ab omnibus amātur fōrmōsissima vocātur.

questions.prompt: Everything that is written by the poet will be read by later generations.
questions.answer: Omnia quae ā poētā scrībuntur ā posterīs legentur.

questions.prompt: The city will be defended as long as the walls stand.
questions.answer: Urbs dēfendētur dum moenia stant.

questions.prompt: Frightened by the omen, the crowd was being driven from the temple.
questions.answer: Ōmine territa, turba ē templō agēbātur.

questions.prompt: With the gates opened, the citizens were being received into the safe camp.
questions.answer: Portīs apertīs, cīvēs in tūta castra recipiēbantur.

questions.prompt: Wounded in battle, the leader will be carried home by his companions.
questions.answer: In proeliō vulnerātus, dux ā comitibus domum portābitur.

questions.prompt: The pregnant she-goat is fed with green fodder every morning.
questions.answer: Capella gravida omnī māne viridī pābulō alitur.

questions.prompt: The pine trees on the mountain are shaken by the pestilent winds.
questions.answer: Pīnūs in monte ventīs pestiferīs quatiuntur.

questions.prompt: The goods for sale were being displayed in the crowded market.
questions.answer: Mercēs vēnālēs in forō frequentī mōnstrābantur.
